text: The assistant was asked to solve a target-number puzzle: make 259 using 6, 10, 25, and 75, with +, −, ×, ÷, using each number at most once and never producing 250 as an intermediate. After repeated unsuccessful attempts, an exact brute-force search found no expression satisfying the rules. The user confirmed the puzzle has no solution and asked to leave it there; the assistant acknowledged that conclusion.

The user asked for 259 using 6, 10, 25, and 75 at most once each, with +, −, ×, and ÷, and 250 forbidden as an intermediate. After several incorrect attempts, the assistant concluded there was no solution. The user independently checked and confirmed the puzzle has no solution, then said to leave it there. The assistant acknowledged that, and the conversation ended.

The user asked the assistant to make 259 from 6, 10, 25, and 75 using +, −, ×, and ÷, using each number at most once and never making 250 as an intermediate result. The assistant made several incorrect attempts and eventually concluded there was no solution. The user independently checked and confirmed the puzzle has no solution, then asked to leave it there. The assistant agreed.
